name: IReNe
aliases: Instant Recoloring of Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A method for instant 360-degree recoloring of pre-trained NeRFs using a single user-edited image, addressing color bleeding at object boundaries and ensuring multi-view consistency for view-dependent effects.
summary: IReNe instantly recolors Neural Radiance Fields by selectively fine-tuning diffuse neurons to prevent color bleeding and preserve view-dependent effects.
